Phase 01

Interactive Prototype

We start with design — not code. Every screen across all six modules gets designed and wired into a fully clickable prototype. You walk through the entire product before a single line of code is written.

  • Brand-aligned design system (colour, type, spacing)
  • All guest app screens — menu, ordering, loyalty, tracking
  • All admin screens — orders, menu, inventory, offers, dashboard
  • Clickable Figma prototype for team walkthrough
  • Revisions based on your feedback before build begins
Phase 02

Full Build

Approved designs go into development. All six modules built and integrated — guest app, admin panel, loyalty engine, inventory, and reporting. Weekly check-ins keep everyone aligned.

  • Guest app — menu browse, ordering, live tracking
  • Loyalty engine — points, tiers, rewards, birthday offers
  • Admin — live order queue and menu management
  • Admin — inventory tracking, adjustments, alerts
  • Admin — offers config, customer view, sales dashboard
  • Weekly progress check-ins throughout
Phase 03

Handover & Support

We walk through the complete product with your team, set up the admin, and make sure everyone is confident running it day-to-day. A support window follows for any questions or tweaks.

  • Full team walkthrough of all admin features
  • Menu, loyalty, and offers configured for go-live
  • Documentation for managing day-to-day operations
  • Post-launch support window
